rules.description: The HTTP client has been migrated from httpx to httpx2. Applications using custom HTTPX clients, transports, or configuration objects must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents or use the temporary, runtime-only legacy HTTPX escape hatch.
rules.evidence: Makes HTTPX2 the default HTTP client for the next major Python SDK release. See the HTTPX Migration Guide for complete customer-facing migration instructions.
